title: Run token claims
description: Payload of the signed JWT the control plane issues for a run (ADR 0003) and the worker sends on every tool gateway call. Signed with ES256 (ECDSA P-256, SHA-256); the JWT header carries `kid`, the id of the signing key, so keys can rotate. A new token is issued on every GET /internal/runs/{id}, valid for the run's budget.max_seconds from issue. Rules not expressible here, checked by the gateway in code: the signature, `exp` > `iat`, the token not yet expired, `require_approval` a subset of `tools`. The gateway never logs the token.

aud.description: Audience: only the tool gateway accepts it.

acts_as.description: Whose credential the gateway uses: `team-bot` (the tenant's bot, for example a GitHub App installation) or `owner` (the identity in `owner`).

owner.description: Who published this agent version; with acts_as owner, whose OAuth token is used.

started_by.description: What started the run, for the gateway's access log: `webhook:github`, `api:<tenant>`, later `user:<id>`.

tools.description: The spec's tools: the only ones the gateway lists or runs for this token.

require_approval.description: Tools the gateway runs only after confirming an approved decision with the control plane.

exp.description: Expires at, epoch seconds: iat + budget.max_seconds.
